name: Sonarchy
author: SurreptitiousFabric
description: Keyboard-first local Sonos playback, library, playlist, alarm, room, and device controls

barWidget.description: Playback, library, playlists, alarms, grouping, search, and device settings

schema.label: Bar appearance
schema.description: Show only the themed Sonos icon, the room name, or scrolling now-playing text.

schema.label: Maximum bar label width
schema.description: Maximum width of the optional scrolling bar text in pixels.

schema.label: Show artwork
schema.description: Show album and result artwork in the popup.

schema.label: Find radio track artwork
schema.description: When the popup is open, use title and artist metadata to find a confident public Apple catalogue artwork match.

schema.label: Popup width
schema.description: Preferred popup width in pixels; Omarchy still fits it to the screen.

schema.label: Popup height
schema.description: Preferred popup height in pixels; page contents scroll when needed.

schema.label: Volume step
schema.description: Percentage changed by keyboard volume shortcuts.
